note: Hosted model providers, kept as DATA rather than as source. Written into gates.ts they would be the very strings the no-fallback gate looks for, and the gate would fail on its own definition. Exempting the checker from the check is how a rule goes inert, so the list moved instead.
cloud_note: The one hosted provider the cloud module (src/cloud/) may name, chosen per folder by its owner; everywhere else every host above, this one included, still fails the no-fallback gate.
